title: CIS
description:
In the custom item survival server, you get to explore 2 new worlds filled with content, structures and biomes. There are many new items to craft and obtain to enhance the vanilla experience; see you soon in cis!

- TheDv_void
body: a very fun server packed with amazing and unique custom weapons and tools. It’s the perfect place to spice up both PvP and survival gameplay. The balanced economy keeps things fair and rewarding, making progression enjoyable without ruining the experience. Great for players looking for something fresh and exciting.
